text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The one who's gonna be number one in Japan 
is me!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross breaks away! Tamamo Cross is 
pulling ahead!! Tamamo Cross in the lead! 
She crosses the line!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Damn it all... Even though I lost, I feel 
totally refreshed, damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(After seeing a run like that, how could I 
not get fired up...?!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Just you wait, Tama. Someday, I swear... 
I'll catch up to where you are...!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Both Oguri and Inari are 
completely raring for payback, aren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going even further ahead. If you 
think you can catch up... just try it!"
